name: Graham Hill
features: pencil moustache, dark hair immaculately parted, long face, wry theatrical expression, London bearing
bio: Came to racing late and by the back door — he swept the floors at Lotus for nothing in exchange for drives. Spent 1958 and 1959 in the fragile Lotus 16, retiring from almost everything, before the titles and the Triple Crown came later. Never a natural, and made up for it by working harder than anyone in the pit lane.
